items.description: Between 1 and 50 Feed Connections to create. No element may be null.

AccountType.description: The high-level type of the account. `BANK` covers every account type other than a credit card.

accountToken.description:
The financial institute's identifier for the account. Must be unique within your
financial institute.

accountNumber.description:
The account number for the Xero Bank Account being created. Up to 40 characters when
`accountType` is `BANK`. When `accountType` is `CREDITCARD`, supply only the last four
digits, and digits only.

accountName.description:
The name for the Xero Bank Account being created. Rejected if the Organisation already
holds an account with this name.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Must be a currency the Organisation holds.

country.description:
ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code. Required only when the Application supports multiple
regions.
